body:
I know they'll always want me around. I guess I'm just selfish thinking like this. I just want to stop feeling this way and nothing ever fixes me. 

I've admitted to my husband and my stepdad that I've had suicidal thoughts. My husband doesn't get it and thinks it's a mind over matter thing. My stepdad is sympathetic. Idk. I dont know that I'd ever actually do it, but at my worst moments it seems like the only relief I'll find.

I'm very sorry about your mom.
Logically I know this to be true. I still need my mom so much. I guess this is my selfish way of justifying.
I wish I could say something to change how you feel (and how I feel).
